# Penguin Statistics (企鹅物流数据统计)

> Crowdsourced Arknights (明日方舟) item drop statistics for the CN, US, JP and KR game servers: how often each stage drops each item, counted from the results players submit. Public REST API to read the data, no key needed. Data licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.

How to read the numbers: drop rate = quantity / times, the expected number of the item per run (it can exceed 1). `times` is the number of runs, the sample size; a rate from fewer than 100 runs is noisy. Each (stage, item) pair has its own time window [start, end) in UTC epoch milliseconds; `end: null` means the stage drops the item now. Always pass and name the server (CN, US, JP or KR; US is the global English server) and say when the data is from. Use the API rather than the website, which is a JavaScript app. Send a User-Agent that names your program and a contact, accept gzip, and cache responses for at least 5 minutes.

Domains: penguin-stats.io serves users and agents worldwide. penguin-stats.cn is the mainland China mirror and may be unreachable from elsewhere: use .io.

## API

- [OpenAPI spec](https://penguin-stats.io/swagger/doc.json): machine-readable contract of the public API (Swagger 2.0)
- [API catalog](https://penguin-stats.io/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 list of the APIs with their specs, docs and license
- [Developer docs](https://developer.penguin-stats.io/public-api): guides for humans; Markdown index at https://developer.penguin-stats.io/public-api/llms.txt
- [Matrix API guide](https://developer.penguin-stats.io/public-api/api-v2-instruction/matrix-api.md): the drop data; narrow it with `itemFilter` or `stageFilter`, as the whole matrix of a server is up to about 1 MB
- [Drops of one item](https://penguin-stats.io/PenguinStats/api/v2/result/matrix?server=CN&itemFilter=30012): example call, Orirock Cube (30012) on every open CN stage
- [Stages](https://penguin-stats.io/PenguinStats/api/v2/stages?server=CN): stage IDs, codes and sanity costs of a server; large, fetch once and cache
- [Items](https://penguin-stats.io/PenguinStats/api/v2/items): item IDs with names in zh, en, ja and ko, and nicknames, which several items can share
- [Zones](https://penguin-stats.io/PenguinStats/api/v2/zones): chapters and events with their opening and closing times per server

## Stats pages

- [Sitemap](https://penguin-stats.io/sitemap.xml): server-rendered page of every item and stage, per server, in zh, en, ja and ko
